assumptions: Existing spring-cloud-data and spring-cloud-stream codebases are available, buildable, and we are extending them.
A single developer with full project context performs all work; no external dependencies or waiting on other teams.
DockerHub credentials and a screen-recording tool are available; screencast effort mainly covers building the demo and minimal editing.
A workday equals 8 productive hours; estimates are single most-likely point estimates excluding calendar delays.
For U1, the fallback when no binding is configured defaults to an in-memory message bus for local development.
Runtime dependency resolution isolates versions per module via classloaders rather than build-time shading.
U7 delivers a design and skeleton only; actual migration of XD modules is out of scope.
Unit and integration tests are included within feature activities; an additional overall integration pass is accounted for.

activities.activity_description: Research how to include/exclude message bus/binding jars on the classpath and define binding selection and fallback approach (U1).
Implement conditional configuration for binding selection and a fallback mechanism when no binding is set up (U1).
Design approach to resolve conflicting jar versions at runtime using Maven Resolver and isolated classloaders (U2).
Develop the dependency resolution capability that fetches and loads the correct module versions in isolated classloaders at runtime (U2).
Create unit and integration tests verifying correct version resolution and fallback behavior for conflicting modules (U2).
Create a multi-stage Dockerfile, build the s-c-d image, and configure incremental push to DockerHub (U3).
Develop a sample firehose|counter pipe using s-c-s, verify it runs, and record/publish a public screencast demonstrating the dev experience (U4).
Brainstorm and document a uniform undeploy strategy for both jobs and streams as a prerequisite for singlenode undeploy (U5).
Implement the undeploy operation for the singlenode (single JVM) target to stop and remove a running stream via the Admin API (U5).
Test undeploy for singlenode streams, including cleanup of resources and consistency with the undeploy strategy (U5).
Design how Spring profiles back the stream repository with different backend strategies in the core Admin application (U6).
Refactor Admin to use profiles and implement the in-memory stream repository for the 'local' profile plus interfaces for other backends (U6).
Verify profile activation selects the correct stream repository backend and metadata is stored/retrieved properly (U6).
Brainstorm and design the foundation for porting XD modules as s-c-s modules, defining structure and migration path (U7).
Scaffold a skeleton s-c-s module project following the designed foundation to serve as a base for future XD migrations (U7).
Add support to expose counter (metrics) endpoints, e.g., via Actuator or custom REST, for consumption by dashboards (U8).
Test counter endpoints and wire them into the firehose|counter demo to feed dashboards (U8).
Perform cross-feature integration testing of the increment in a single JVM and Docker environment, fixing defects.
Document new capabilities (profiles, undeploy, dependency resolution, metrics, Docker image) for developers and users.
